contract: OpenID Connect login/callback/logout/auto-redirect flow parity with upstream OpenIDAuthStrategy, including settings side effects.

invariants.contract: Web auto-registration success redirects to the configured callback with tokens and persists the provider subject, user fields, and exactly one refresh session; provider error, state replay, expired ID token, and disabled auto-registration match upstream response routing and create no additional user or session.
exceptions: Evidence covers the named web flow cases only; it does not establish all callback cookies, mobile, or event behavior.

invariants.contract: When authOpenIDMatchExistingBy=email finds an active unlinked user, callback links the provider subject to that user, creates one session, and retains the existing extraData member order when appending authOpenIDSub.
Successful OIDC auto-registration emits one user_added payload with the legacy browser user shape to root/admin sockets and does not deliver it to an ordinary user socket.
exceptions: Evidence covers the selected auto-registration event and admin-versus-reader recipient distinction only; the full Socket.IO event matrix remains open.

evidence: go-backend/contracts/parity/oidc-differential-report.json (pinned upstream v2.37.2: six web callback/state/persistence cases, 6/6 matched; includes one real-socket user_added recipient/payload case; see provenance for exact limits)
exceptions: Invalid signature/issuer/audience/nonce, mobile flow, flow-state expiry, detailed cookie attributes, and the general Socket.IO event inventory remain unverified.
OIDC capability normal/error/edge categories remain unverified as a whole despite six matched cases; no full OIDC parity claim is made.
Force/refresh is not an OIDC operation in the pinned route contract; the capability has no force scenario.
